deploy.startCommand: sh -c "echo '=== Checking alembic version ===' && python3 /app/check_alembic_version.py 2>&1 && echo '=== Running alembic upgrade heads ===' && alembic upgrade heads 2>&1 && echo '=== Ensuring columns ===' && python3 /app/ensure_columns.py 2>&1 && echo '=== Checking tables ===' && python3 /app/check_columns.py 2>&1 && echo '=== Starting uvicorn ===' && uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}"
